## Simple Bayes Agent (SBA)
```{r}
SimpleAgent_stan <- "
// Simple Bayesian Agent (SBA).
// No free parameters — evidence is counted at face value.
// Jeffreys prior pseudo-counts: alpha0 = beta0 = 0.5.
data {
  int<lower=1> N;
  array[N] int<lower=0, upper=1> choice;
  array[N] int<lower=0> blue1;
  array[N] int<lower=0> total1;
  array[N] int<lower=0> blue2;
  array[N] int<lower=0> total2;
}

model {
  // Vectorized likelihood with fixed weights = 1
  vector[N] alpha_post = 0.5 + to_vector(blue1) + to_vector(blue2);
  vector[N] beta_post  = 0.5 + (to_vector(total1) - to_vector(blue1))
                             + (to_vector(total2) - to_vector(blue2));
                             
  target += beta_binomial_lpmf(choice | 1, alpha_post, beta_post);
}

generated quantities {
  vector[N] log_lik;
  array[N] int posterior_pred;

  for (i in 1:N) {
    real alpha_post = 0.5 + blue1[i] + blue2[i];
    real beta_post  = 0.5 + (total1[i] - blue1[i]) + (total2[i] - blue2[i]);

    log_lik[i]        = beta_binomial_lpmf(choice[i] | 1, alpha_post, beta_post);
    posterior_pred[i] = beta_binomial_rng(1, alpha_post, beta_post);
  }
}
"

write_stan_file(SimpleAgent_stan,
                dir      = "stan/",
                basename = "ch9_simple_agent.stan")
```


## Weighted Bayes Agent (WBA)
```{r}
WeightedAgentRaw_stan <- "
// Weighted Bayesian Agent (raw parameterisation).
// w_d, w_s > 0: independent weights on direct and social evidence.
// Jeffreys prior pseudo-counts (0.5) consistent with SBA.
data {
  int<lower=1> N;
  array[N] int<lower=0, upper=1> choice;
  array[N] int<lower=0> blue1;
  array[N] int<lower=0> total1;
  array[N] int<lower=0> blue2;
  array[N] int<lower=0> total2;
}

parameters {
  real<lower=0> weight_direct;  // w_d
  real<lower=0> weight_social;  // w_s
}

model {
  // Priors: lognormal centered on 1 (evidence taken at face value)
  target += lognormal_lpdf(weight_direct | 0, 0.5);
  target += lognormal_lpdf(weight_social | 0, 0.5);

  // Vectorized likelihood
  vector[N] alpha_post = 0.5 + weight_direct * to_vector(blue1)
                             + weight_social * to_vector(blue2);
  vector[N] beta_post  = 0.5 + weight_direct * (to_vector(total1) - to_vector(blue1))
                             + weight_social * (to_vector(total2) - to_vector(blue2));
                             
  target += beta_binomial_lpmf(choice | 1, alpha_post, beta_post);
}

generated quantities {
  vector[N] log_lik;
  array[N] int posterior_pred;

  for (i in 1:N) {
    real alpha_post = 0.5 + weight_direct * blue1[i] + weight_social * blue2[i];
    real beta_post  = 0.5 + weight_direct * (total1[i] - blue1[i]) 
                         + weight_social * (total2[i] - blue2[i]);

    log_lik[i]        = beta_binomial_lpmf(choice[i] | 1, alpha_post, beta_post);
    posterior_pred[i] = beta_binomial_rng(1, alpha_post, beta_post);
  }
}
"

write_stan_file(WeightedAgentRaw_stan,
                dir      = "stan/",
                basename = "ch9_weighted_agent_raw.stan")
```

```{r}
N <- 80 #number of faces

first_rating <- runif(N, 1, 8)
group_rating <- runif(N, 1, 8)
```



```{r}
# Core belief-update function implementing the Beta-Binomial integration model
betaBinomialModel <- function(alpha_prior = 0.5, beta_prior = 0.5,
                              first_rating, group_rating, max_rating, #changed it to one max rating and the name
                              w_direct = 1, w_social = 1) {
  
  alpha_post <- alpha_prior + w_direct * first_rating + w_social * group_rating
  beta_post  <- beta_prior  + w_direct * (max_rating - first_rating) +
    w_social * (max_rating - group_rating)
  
  expected_rate <- alpha_post / (alpha_post + beta_post)
  ci_lower      <- qbeta(0.025, alpha_post, beta_post)
  ci_upper      <- qbeta(0.975, alpha_post, beta_post)
  
  list(
    alpha_post    = alpha_post,
    beta_post     = beta_post,
    expected_rate = expected_rate,
    ci_lower      = ci_lower,
    ci_upper      = ci_upper
  )
}

# Function to generate decisions from a simulated agent
generate_agent_decisions <- function(weight_direct, weight_social,
                                     evidence_df, n_samples = 80) {
  evidence_df |>
    slice(rep(seq_len(n()), each = n_samples)) |>
    group_by(first_rating, group_rating, max_rating) |>
    mutate(sample_id = seq_len(n())) |>
    ungroup() |>
    pmap_dfr(function(first_rating, group_rating, max_rating, sample_id) {
      result <- betaBinomialModel(
        0.5, 0.5, first_rating, group_rating, max_rating,
        w_direct = weight_direct, w_social = weight_social
      )
      # Probability matching: sample θ from Beta, then sample choice from Bernoulli(θ)
      alpha_p <- result$alpha_post
      beta_p  <- result$beta_post
      p       <- rbeta(1, alpha_p, beta_p)
      tibble(
        sample_id     = sample_id,
        first_rating  = first_rating,
        group_rating  = group_rating,
        max_rating    = max_rating,
        expected_rate = result$expected_rate,
        second_rating       = rbinom(1, 8, p)
      )
    })
}

prepare_stan_data <- function(df) {
  list(
    N             = nrow(df),
    second_rating = df$second_rating,
    first_rating  = df$first_rating,
    max_rating    = df$max_rating,
    group_rating  = df$group_rating
  )
}

```


```{r}
# Calculate SBA predictions for all evidence combinations
sim_data <- evidence_combinations |>
  pmap_dfr(function(first_rating, group_rating, max_rating) {
    result <- betaBinomialModel(0.5, 0.5, first_rating, group_rating, max_rating)
    tibble(
      first_rating  = first_rating,
      group_rating  = group_rating,
      expected_rate = result$expected_rate,
      ci_lower      = result$ci_lower,
      ci_upper      = result$ci_upper
    )
  })



ggplot(sim_data,
       aes(x = first_rating, y = expected_rate,
           colour = group_rating, group = group_rating)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper,
                  fill = group_rating), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:8) +
  #scale_colour_manual(values = semantic_colors) +
  #scale_fill_manual(values = semantic_colors) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Simple Bayesian Agent: Evidence Integration",
    subtitle = "Expected proportion with 95% credible intervals | Weights fixed at (1, 1)",
    x        = "first rating out of 8",
    y        = "Expected rate",
    colour   = "Group rating",
    fill     = "Group rating"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```


# 10.7
```{r}
agents <- tibble(
  agent_type    = c("Self-Focused", "Balanced", "Socially-Influenced"),
  weight_direct = c(1.5, 1.0, 0.5),
  weight_social = c(0.5, 1.0, 2.0)
)

# Generate simulated data for all three agent types
simulation_results <- agents |>
  pmap_dfr(function(agent_type, weight_direct, weight_social) {
    generate_agent_decisions(weight_direct, weight_social,
                             evidence_combinations, n_samples = 5) |>
      mutate(agent_type = agent_type)
  }) |>
  mutate(
    agent_type = factor(
      agent_type,
      levels = c("Self-Focused", "Balanced", "Socially-Influenced")
    )
  )

# Summarize for plotting
plot_summary <- simulation_results |>
  group_by(agent_type, first_rating, group_rating) |>
  summarise(
    theoretical_p = mean(expected_rate)*7+1,
    empirical_p   = mean(second_rating),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Visualize
ggplot(plot_summary, aes(x = first_rating, colour = group_rating, group = group_rating)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = theoretical_p), linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = empirical_p), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(y = empirical_p), size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey30") +
  facet_wrap(~ agent_type) +
  #scale_colour_manual(values = semantic_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:8) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1, 8)) +
  labs(
    title = "Weighted Bayesian Agents: Three Scenarios",
    subtitle = "Solid faded = Internal Belief | Dashed = Observed Choice Proportions (N=5 per condition)",
    x = "Blue marbles in direct sample (out of 8)",
    y = "Second rating",
    colour = "Social evidence"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))
```

```{r}
mod_simple       <- cmdstan_model("stan/ch9_simple_agent.stan")
mod_weighted_raw <- cmdstan_model("stan/ch9_weighted_agent_raw.stan")

sampler_args <- list(
  chains = 4, 
  parallel_chains = 4, 
  iter_warmup = 1000, 
  iter_sampling = 1000, 
  refresh = 0
)
```

```{r}
# True values for the three WBA scenarios
true_wba <- list(
  Self_Focused        = list(wd = 1.5, ws = 0.5),
  Balanced            = list(wd = 1.0, ws = 1.0),
  Socially_Influenced = list(wd = 0.5, ws = 2.0)
)

# Generate simulated data for each scenario
stan_data_wba <- map(true_wba, function(params) {
  sim <- generate_agent_decisions(
    params$wd, params$ws, 
    evidence_combinations, 
    n_samples = 5
  ) |> mutate(total1 = 8L, total2 = 3L)
  prepare_stan_data(sim)
})
```

```{r}
regenerate_simulations <- TRUE
```


```{r}
fit_sba_paths <- here::here(
  "simmodels",
  paste0("ch9_fit_sba_", names(stan_data_wba), ".rds")
) |> set_names(names(stan_data_wba))

if (regenerate_simulations || !all(file.exists(fit_sba_paths))) {
  fit_sba <- imap(stan_data_wba, function(data, scenario) {
    fit <- mod_simple$sample(
      data          = data,
      chains        = 2,
      iter_warmup   = 0,
      iter_sampling = 1000,
      fixed_param   = TRUE,
      refresh       = 0
    )
    fit$save_object(fit_sba_paths[[scenario]])
    fit
  })
} else {
  fit_sba <- map(fit_sba_paths, readRDS)
}
```
